recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-12731 unless Patient Care later reopens the broader negation modeling question.
issue_request: FHIR-12731 asked whether Condition.verificationStatus code refuted should be expanded to cover asserter/patient denial, or whether a denied code should be added for statements such as a patient never having had chicken pox or not having asthma. The final Published resolution was Not Persuasive with Modification: keep the existing absence guidance and add a note saying that patient denial of a condition can be annotated in Condition.note.
initial_application: Historical commit 6e701e5ef7be2338059f27c6f3a397c01fd10d85 explicitly mentioned #12731 and added the Patient Denies Condition note to source/condition/condition-notes.xml. Later commit 005f3df50afc07ae825c55698ac247ac81eb4882 restored condition-notes.xml after accidental deletion and retained the FHIR-12731 note and related absence guidance.
additional_context: Condition is active in source/fhir.ini, so the Condition source folder remains in current build scope. Current source/condition/valueset-condition-ver-status.xml composes the Condition verification status value set from the THO condition-ver-status code system instead of adding a local denied code. The linked Zulip discussion shows the original concern that refuted/status should not be overloaded with unconfirmed absence or patient assertion semantics. Searches found no Confluence references and no later directly matching Jira issue that changes the conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because no source edit is needed. Current source/condition/condition-notes.xml already includes the exact Condition.note patient-denial sentence and the surrounding guidance distinguishing refuted Conditions from checklist-style assertions of absence captured with QuestionnaireResponse or Observation.
